description: Find studies, germplasm, or observations across BrAPI connection aliases. Reuses each finder’s filters, dialect handling, and read limits. Rows retain their source alias and DbId. Only an unambiguous exact germplasm PUI can group records across aliases. Returns per-alias coverage and stages the merged collection when the inline limit is reached.

aliases.description: Source aliases to query in the order given.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline in results[]. Omit for the deployment default. results[] also stops at a 24,000-byte budget, whichever bound comes first, and keeps at least one row when any matched. When results[] holds fewer rows than matched, the matched rows are staged in a dataframe (marked truncated if the upstream walk stopped short); query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

crop.description: Filter by common crop name (single value).

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

locations.description: Filter by locationDbIds (server-side identifiers, not display names). On servers that ignore this filter on /studies, it is applied client-side over the scanned studies, and a study with no locationDbId never matches.

variables.description: Filter by observationVariableDbIds — studies that recorded these variables. Get IDs from brapi_find_variables.

accessionNumbers.description: Filter by accession numbers (gene-bank catalog codes).

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

text.description: Free-text query. Applied client-side as a case-insensitive substring match on germplasmName, germplasmPUI, accessionNumber, defaultDisplayName, and registered synonyms — no BrAPI server reliably supports a server-side free-text filter. Every upstream row is scanned when the filtered set fits one dataframe walk; above that, a miss on the first page stops the scan, and the warnings report how many rows were checked. Combine with `crops` / `genus` / etc. to narrow the upstream pull first.

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

observationLevels.description: Observation unit level (plot, plant, field, etc.).

timestampFrom.description: ISO 8601 start of the observation-time window.

timestampTo.description: ISO 8601 end of the observation-time window.

name: brapi_federated_find

complete.description: True when all source scans completed.

coverage.description: Collection coverage in alias input order.

status.description: Whether the source completed its scan.

warnings.description: Filter and coverage warnings from the finder.

recovery.description: How to retry or correct the source failure.

status.description: Source failed, or the shared deadline prevented dispatch.

dataframe.description: Merged table when the preview is cut.

columnLegend.description: SQL-safe name → original upstream key for renamed columns. Use the safe names in SQL.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiry of this dataframe’s provenance metadata.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Matched total for complete local scans; else upstream total. Omitted for incomplete local scans or unknown totals.

truncated.description: True for a capped, failed, timed-out, incomplete, or skipped pull; warnings explains why.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Preview bound and pointer to the merged dataframe.

results.description: Leading merged rows with source provenance.

items.description: One merged row and its source records.

conflicts.description: Fields reported with different non-null values by PUI group members.

sources.description: One source row or the members of an exact germplasm PUI group.

alias.description: Connection alias qualifying the source record.

record.description: The finder record from this source.

truncated.description: True when the merged inline preview was cut.
